answer_text: Cato recommends bypassing certificate-pinned apps from TLS inspection by adding them to the TLS inspection bypass rules. If a pinned app still fails due to pinning or strict certificate validation, configure a targeted TLS inspection bypass for that app. The KB also notes default bypass rules for well-known applications and platforms, but it does not provide a specific list of operating systems that are automatically bypassed. When enforcing TLS inspection on platforms such as Android or Linux, validate compatibility carefully.
